chapters.label: Semi-final, live
chapters.text: Amsterdam, 2000. Italy and the Netherlands go to penalties. Francesco Totti tells his teammates: I'm going to chip it! He strolls up... the keeper dives... and Totti scoops it down the middle. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. Van der Sar leans one way, then dives the other. Totti lifts it softly over him.

chapters.label: From the side
chapters.text: From the side: the ball floats just over the falling keeper. Italy go through to the final!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Be brave, but stay calm. Watch the keeper commit, then choose the empty space.
